title: 岸電供應系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討岸船頻率轉換、接地介面與負載轉移，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore shore/ship frequency conversion, grounding interfaces and load transfer, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。船岸接線、接地、互鎖、同步與操作需合格港務及船舶專業規範；本課只做概念模型。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Connections, grounding, interlocks, synchronization and operations require qualified port/marine engineering; this course uses conceptual models only.

stages.title: 岸船需求
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成岸船需求；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete shore/ship requirements through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 盤點船舶供電需求：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Inventory ship demand: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解盤點船舶供電需求，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand inventory ship demand through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 以需求矩陣比較 50/60 Hz 和兩種船舶電壓，標示需轉換項目。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare 50/60 Hz and two ship voltages in a requirement matrix and mark conversion needs. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 以需求矩陣比較 50/60 Hz 和兩種船舶電壓，標示需轉換項目。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare 50/60 Hz and two ship voltages in a requirement matrix and mark conversion needs. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「盤點船舶供電需求」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把岸船頻率轉換、接地介面與負載轉移的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If inventory ship demand disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of shore/ship frequency conversion, grounding interfaces and load transfer behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「盤點船舶供電需求」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for inventory ship demand, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 盤點船舶供電需求：原理
knowledge.text: 船舶電壓、頻率、相序與功率需求需分別匹配岸側能力。
knowledge.textEn: Ship voltage, frequency, phase sequence and power must separately match shore capability.

knowledge.title: 盤點船舶供電需求：證據
knowledge.text: 以需求矩陣比較 50/60 Hz 和兩種船舶電壓，標示需轉換項目。
knowledge.textEn: Compare 50/60 Hz and two ship voltages in a requirement matrix and mark conversion needs.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：船舶需 3 MW、功率因數 0.9，至少需 3.333 MVA。若船側線電壓 6.6 kV，平衡三相電流約 291.6 A；50 Hz 岸網轉 60 Hz 船網需真正頻率轉換，變壓器本身不會改變頻率。 船岸接線、接地、互鎖、同步與操作需合格港務及船舶專業規範；本課只做概念模型。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: 3 MW at power factor 0.9 requires at least 3.333 MVA. At 6.6 kV line voltage the balanced current is about 291.6 A. Converting a 50 Hz shore grid to a 60 Hz ship grid requires frequency conversion; a transformer alone does not change frequency. Connections, grounding, interlocks, synchronization and operations require qualified port/marine engineering; this course uses conceptual models only.

steps.title: 拆分變壓與變頻：建立模型

steps.failure: 若「拆分變壓與變頻」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把岸船頻率轉換、接地介面與負載轉移的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。

steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for separate voltage and frequency conversion, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.text: 教學例：船舶需 3 MW、功率因數 0.9，至少需 3.333 MVA。若船側線電壓 6.6 kV，平衡三相電流約 291.6 A；50 Hz 岸網轉 60 Hz 船網需真正頻率轉換，變壓器本身不會改變頻率。 船岸接線、接地、互鎖、同步與操作需合格港務及船舶專業規範；本課只做概念模型。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: 3 MW at power factor 0.9 requires at least 3.333 MVA. At 6.6 kV line voltage the balanced current is about 291.6 A. Converting a 50 Hz shore grid to a 60 Hz ship grid requires frequency conversion; a transformer alone does not change frequency. Connections, grounding, interlocks, synchronization and operations require qualified port/marine engineering; this course uses conceptual models only.

steps.title: 計算視在功率：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Calculate apparent power: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解計算視在功率，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand calculate apparent power through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「無功與諧波使額定 kVA 不可只按平均 kW 配置。」的觀察。重算 3 MW、0.9 PF 範例，再檢查負載階躍餘裕。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Reactive power and harmonics mean rated kVA cannot follow average kW alone. Recompute the 3 MW, 0.9 PF example and check load-step margin. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 重算 3 MW、0.9 PF 範例，再檢查負載階躍餘裕。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Recompute the 3 MW, 0.9 PF example and check load-step margin. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「計算視在功率」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把岸船頻率轉換、接地介面與負載轉移的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If calculate apparent power disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of shore/ship frequency conversion, grounding interfaces and load transfer behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「計算視在功率」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for calculate apparent power, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.
